note: DEC-177 requires every new tool to declare its sockets; the manifest schema itself is still with R&D, so this file is provisional and will be migrated when a schema is adopted.
purpose: Build an editorial packet (original + proposed edition + labelled changes + resolved quotations), draft a spec listing every difference for a person to label, record accept/reject/revise decisions, link revisions to their parent packet, report the history of one original, and render a side-by-side HTML review sheet for a packet.

information_in.location: content folder from --home or $PROSPERO_HOME; no default
information_in.planned: MCP information-in resource (DEC-177) behind the same Source interface

writes: a spec skeleton: every difference as an unlabelled change, every quotation declared
information_out.refuses: an existing file, a symlink, any path outside the content folder or inside this repository

information_out.kind: file (self-contained HTML: no scripts, no network)
writes: <stem>.review.html (a view: replaced each time it is generated)
information_out.refuses: any folder inside this repository; a symlink at the sheet's name

needs: read and write the content folder the caller names
authority.note: DEC-185 authority socket; protocol undecided. Decisions are recorded with a typed decider name, which is not authenticated.
